card.name: Unit, supplied and single in dosing text
card.fires_on: Word endings in label phrases such as "How Supplied", "per unit", "single-dose" and "Vials". It is strongest on the last piece of a section title or packaging term.

modes.description: The 'plied' ending of 'How Supplied' in section cross-references or headings.

modes.description: The word 'unit' or 'single' in per-unit or single-dose phrases.
